operationalBoundaries.behavior: When target fixture baseline is dirty or modified prior to Attempt 1, execution aborts immediately with PREFLIGHT_BASELINE_FAILED without dispatching browser actions.
When plan approval lease has expired, TwoAttemptController fails closed immediately without contacting the target network.
When an action is classified as MUTATION_UNCERTAIN, the global execution lease is quarantined for 1 hour and Attempt 2 is blocked.
Catastrophic backtracking nested quantifiers (e.g. (a+)+$) and text bounds are rejected.
operationalBoundaries.unresolvedLimitation: Arbitrary regex evaluation remains exposed to complex overlapping alternation patterns; production deployments should restrict failure signatures to bounded string predicates (EQUALS, CONTAINS) or strict token anchors.
